action.command: cd /workspace && ULI=$(su ddevuser -c "ddev drush uli" 2>&1 | grep -o 'http[^ ]*login' | head -1); curl -s -L -c /tmp/c2.txt -o /dev/null "$ULI"; curl -s -b /tmp/c2.txt -o /tmp/add.html -w "add location: %{http_code}\n" "http://openculturas.ddev.site/en/node/add/location"; grep -oiE "field_osm_id|osm|Get address|address lookup" /tmp/add.html | sort | uniq -c | head; echo "=== node/add/location size ==="; wc -c /tmp/add.html
